status: frozen before expanded retrieval scoring; no tuning
primary_comparison: rerank50 minus rerank20 on all90; also compare each against hybrid
code_rerank_instruction: Given a developer question, retrieve the code that implements the requested behaviour
embedding_query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a developer question or a description of behaviour, retrieve the code that implements it
Query:
proof_rule: Any one labelled sufficient evidence set; at least 90 percent of every required range in that set. Do not combine partial pieces of different alternatives into a complete proof.
timing: Independent actual production calls, rotated ordering, warm synchronized p50/p95 separately per repo. Do not average percentiles. Repetitions are not independent questions.
hardware: A100 for experiments only; deployment hardware undecided
authorship: Source-authored and reviewed by the same assistant; independent review pending
prior_exposure: Retained15 plus newly authored75; overlap with previously assessed v2 evidence is recorded per question. New wording is not independent code or training-data freshness.
decision: No automatic policy/default selection. A CI spanning zero is inconclusive, not equivalence. Inspect MRR, complete proof and test/example guards with latency. Independent review and eventual deployment timing remain required.
scope: Answerable questions over code in three pinned repositories/two languages; not a random production-query distribution, ANN scale test, abstention test or generated-answer accuracy benchmark. No character-vs-AST causal comparison.
